[SWS_CM_05382] No Subscribe resending for initial subscriptions
⌈
The require-
ment [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00463] shall not be applied for initial subscriptions described
in [SWS_CM_10377], the requirement shall only be applied for renewal subscriptions
described in [SWS_CM_10381].
⌋
Note:
This restriction handles the case if an offer message arrives before the first
SubscribeEventgroupAck has arrived. In this case the client shall not send StopSub-
scribeEventgroup entry/SubscribeEventgroup entry.
Rationale:
If a client sends an initial SubscribeEventgroup entry as a reaction to
Sub-
scribe()
method call, which is not synchronized with the server, and an offer arrives
immediately after that but before the SubscribeEventgroupAck entry could be sent by
the server and received, the client shall not complain (i.e. sending StopSubscribe/
Subscribe
) about a not yet received acknowledgement.
